ARCHIVE MAIL TERMINAL A
STAFF MAIL / YEAR 6074
FROM: LENA / GUIDANCE
TO: ARON / SYSTEMS<New>SUBJECT: SHE STAYED AWAKE
Mira watched the whole count.
When the carrier disappeared,
she waved the paper star you
made until her arm hurt.<New>The overseas tracking station
called with a clean signal.
You should have heard us
when their voices came
through.<New>REPLY: ARON / SYSTEMS
Tell Mira her star helped.<Close>

OPERATIONS DESK TERMINAL A
PROGRAM MAIL / YEAR 6072
FROM: FACILITY DIRECTOR
TO: CIVIL LAUNCH BUREAU<New>The next carrier holds
atmospheric instruments
and an unmanned probe.
The rail will give it its
first velocity toward space.<New>The Budget Office asks what
return justifies another
launch while the economy
continues to contract.<New>REPLY: FACILITY DIRECTOR
Not every return appears
on a balance sheet.
Keep the civil window open.<Close>
